notes.title: Fu the mysterious character
notes.content:
[h3]Before we go into the DLC details, let's briefly reminisce about Fu, the elusive character.
Fu is an experimental mutant created by Dabura, who utilized the cells of his sister Demon Queen, Towa, and Demon King, Mira, to revive the Demon Realm. His first appearance was in the extra mission of the paid DLC Extra DLC Pack 2.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=9PfVUh2-Oi4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Fu only has interest in experimentation and research, and not in the revival of the Demon Realm. Due to this, he rebelled against Dabura, and since then, he has repeatedly conducted experiments (incidents) and research on "energy produced by altered history.” The protagonists have found themselves caught in the trenches in the process. [/h3]
[h2][b]
A new form appears?![/b][/h2]
[h3]Ultra supervillain makes its first appearance in DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 FUTURE SAGA Chapter 1 as it is an advanced form of energy collection that Fu has developed. Unlike its predecessor form Supervillain that turns characters berserk and more powerful, this form allows the user to keep full control of their mind while benefiting from their newfound powers. [/h3]

[h2][b]5 New characters join the roster![/b][/h2]
[h3]The Future Saga Chapter1 will bring [b]5 new characters[/b] to DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2, play Vegeta (Super Saiyan God) and Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé) both in their new Ultra Supervillain form, as well as Broly (Restrained), Android 18 (DBSuper) and Videl (DBsuper) with their unique move sets.[/h3]

[h3][b]On top of that, a lot of new content is coming with the DLC:[/b]
-	12 new Parallel Quests
-	3 Extra Missions
-	15 Skills 
-	63 Loading Screens 
-	3 Costumes.
-	5 Super Souls"[/h3]

[h3][b]Players can enjoy the 18th Free Update which will bring to the game:[/b]

-	93 Loading Screen Illustrations
-	5 Super Souls

-	Cross Versus New Feature (1 stage, 4 Badges, 2 Emotions)

notes.title: New anti-cheating tool for DRAGON BALL Xenoverse 2
notes.content:
This Wednesday we will release a new anti-cheating tool for DRAGON BALL Xenoverse 2. It's designed to stop online uses of boosters, gameplay alterations and various cheats contributing to an unfair online environment. This will be seamless and automatically disable cheats, but users who insist on going around the anti-cheat will be banned by the system.
How will this work?


· The game will be updated with the new tool, which will scan the game's binary files to ensure they are identical to the files delivered by the developers. The frequency is going to vary somewhat, but it will not have a performance impact.
This is a new tool so we look forward to your feedback and concerns. Thank you and don’t hesitate to ask questions in this post.

notes.title: DLC 2 updated skills list
notes.content:
Times Patrollers,

Some skills will be updated with the release of DLC 2 (release date to be announced shortly). Please find the list of modified moves below:

Kaioken Assault
[list]
[*]The amount of Ki required to deal attacks during Kaioken Assault is decreased from 500 to 200.
[*]The total damage is also decreased.
[*]After opponent uses Z Vanish during Kaioken Assault attacks, player will be able to recover from the immobile state more quickly.
[/list]
Ki Explosion
[list]
[*]The amount of Ki required to release Ki Explosion is decreased from 200 to 100.
[*]The amount of damage is increased.
[*]The time allowed for consecutive Ki Explosions is shortened.
[*]After releasing a button, player will be able to recover from the immobile state more quickly.
[/list]
x10 Kamehameha
[list]
[*]The amount of Ki required to release x10 Kamehameha is increased from 100 to 200.
[*]The amount of damage is increased.
[*]The attack detection time is shortened for the situation where player unleashes the skill by short button press.
[/list]
Cross Arm Dive
[list]
[*]Player will become Invincible right after the skill is used.
[*]Player can move the character forward, backward, to the right and left by moving the left stick during jump.
[*]Also player can move the character by moving the left stick more quickly while falling to the ground.
[/list]
Dodon Ray
[list]
[*]After unleashing Dodon Ray, player will be able to recover from the immobile state more quickly.
[/list]
Mighty Explosive Wave
[list]
[*]The amount of damage is increased.
[/list]
Crazy Finger Shot
[list]
[*]The amount of damage is gradually increased by consecutively releasing Crazy Finger Shots.
[/list]
Burning Attack
[list]
[*]Opponent is able to guard in less time after being hit. Instead, when opponent gets hit by the skill consecutively, he/she will be blown away.
[*]Burning Attack will vaguely follow the opponent.
[/list]
Go-Go Gum
[list]
[*]The time the skill binds opponent is shortened.
[/list]
Rolling Hercule Punch
[list]
[*]Increased the number of additional roll from 1 to 2. The range of hit detection is enlarged.
[*]The amount of damage is increased.
[*]Player character will not wince if being attacked just before throwing a punch.
[/list]
Punisher Drive
[list]
[*]Player can guard the last attack.
[/list]
Gigantic Meteor
[list]
[*]The hit detection time is shortened.
[/list]
Hell Flash
[list]
[*]The amount of damage is increased.
[/list]
Purification
[list]
[*]The amount of Stamina automatically consumed during Purification is decreased.
[*]The immobile period is shorter after unleashing the Kick Hit (Circle button).
[*]Also, opponent will not be able to guard for a longer time.
[*]Player will be able to change direction more quickly when dashing.
[/list]
Absolute Zero
[list]
[*]Hit detection time is shortened.
[*]The immobile period will apply when unleashing this skill in any situations now.
[*]The frozen period of opponent is shortened.
[/list]
God of Destruction's Anger
[list]
[*]The amount of Ki consumed is increased from 100 to 200.
[*]Also, player cannot unleash this skill right after normal attacks.
[/list]
Thunder Eraser
[list]
[*]Opponent can use Z Vanish more quickly after being hit by this skill.
[/list]
Dragon Burn
[list]
[*]Opponent can use Z Vanish more quickly after being hit by this skill.
[/list]
Fake Blast
[list]
[*]Opponent can use Z Vanish more quickly after being hit by this skill.
[/list]
Shockwave
[list]
[*]Opponent can use Z Vanish more quickly after being hit by this skill while guarding.
[/list]
Ki Blast Cannon
[list]
[*]Opponent can use Z Vanish more quickly after being hit by this skill while being blown away.
[/list]
Dragon Fist
[list]
[*]Opponent can avoid this skill by Z Vanish.
[/list]

notes.title: Frieza’s Siege and other holidays events!
notes.content:
Dear Time Patrollers, 

Holidays is the perfect moment to spend time in Conton City, and we have planned several events during the Holiday period! 

[h1]Frieza Siege Event[/h1]

Frieza is attacking Conton City with his army! His soldiers will be present at different places in Conton City and will attack on sight, so be ready to fight. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786264/9236ee445d9c434524cc5937823fc5ad30cd0adf.jpg[/img]

The event will take place every day from December 23rd to December 29th, between 18.00 CET and 21.00 CET (Europe) and 10.00 to 13.00 PST (NA/LATAM) 

The players who have proven their courage against Frieza’s Army will be given the following nicknames depending on their performance: 
[list]
[*]1st place: Nickname “TP1”
[*]2nd to 50th place: Nickname “Defender”
[*]51st to 200th place: Nickname “Apprentice”
[/list]
And depending on the enemy you fight against, you will be able to acquire the Frieza Army Jerseys! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25786264/d2ba9b74ff5918831e92be8a39c442cb19f67313.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bonus Experience Points[/h1]

During the following period, you will be able to gain 1.25 times more experience points!
[list]
[*]From December 23rd 1am CET to December 27th 1am CET
[*]From December 30th 1am CET to January 4th 1am CET
[/list]
[h1]New Raid Bosses: Hit & Broly[/h1]

Two new bosses will threaten Conton City! Gather your forces and bring the fight to them! 

The Hit Raid will be available on December 27th from Noon to Midnight CET for Europe and on December 26th from 10.00am to 10.00pm PST for NA/LATAM.
[list]
[*]All players who participate will receive 1 Hercule’s Badge (Common)
[*]5 000 damage done: Nickname “Slayer”
[*]50 000 damage done: Super Soul “I’m over 1 000 years old”
[*]100 000 damage done: Nickname “Executioner”
[*]If Hit is beaten at level 99, all players who participated will receive 30 TP Medals
[*]The team of 6 players who deliver the Final Blow will receive an additional 30 TP Medals
[/list]
The Broly Raid will take place on January 2nd from Noon to Midnight CET for Europe and on January 1st from 10.00am to 10.00pm PST for NA/LATAM.
[list]
[*]All players who participate will receive 1 Hercule’s Badge (Common)
[*]5 000 damage done: Nickname “Violent”
[*]50 000 damage done: Nickname “Berserker” and 20 TP Medals
[*]100 000 damage done: Nickname “The Ultimate Weapon”
[*]If Broly is beaten at level 99, all players who participated will receive 30 TP Medals
[*]The team of 6 players who deliver the Final Blow will receive an additional 30 TP Medals
[/list]
Older Raid Bosses will make an apparition during the holidays, so keep an eye on the skies of Conton City! Please note that those fights will only have TP medals and Hercule’s Badges as rewards. 

Good Holidays Time Patrollers!

Show your strength in the 1st Tenkaichi Tournament which will soon start in Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2! 

The Tenkaichi Tournament will be divided into 4 phases which all players can enter. You can rise in the leaderboards and earn prizes! Once all phases are finished, your points will be accumulated and the best overall players will receive additional prizes (to be unveiled later).
[list]
[*]1st phase: November 25th 21:00 (CET) - November 28th 09:00 (CET) - OVER
[*]2nd phase: November 28th 21:00 (CET) - December 1st 09:00 (CET)
[*]3rd phase: December 2nd 21:00 (CET) - December 5th 09:00 (CET)
[*]4th phase: December 5th 21:00 (CET) - December 8th 09:00 (CET)

notes.content:
Time Patrollers, 

A new update will be deployed shortly on STEAM to improve your experience and include the 1.03 patch released last week on consoles. In the addition of the 1.03 changes, this patch aims to improve several STEAM issues you have reported. [b]This patch will be deployed on November 23rd at 17.00 CET[/b].

[h1]1.03 update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where a particular challenge quest could not be completed depending on the combination of the avatar race or build

[list]
[*]Fixed issues showing wrong button prompts when playing with Mouse & Keyboard and with controllers
[*]Fixed Keyboards functionality issues
[*]Fixed jumping affected by framerate issues
[*]Fixed issues with minimizing
[*]Fixed issues with disconnecting/reconnecting controllers
[*]Fixed issues when random allies and enemies would move out of the “Saiyan Siege! Defend the Earth” mission.
[*]Fixed the issue when Geat Ape Vegeta would disappear after throwing the Gigantic Ki Blast
[*]Fixed the issue when enemies would get stuck out of the game environment after throwing the Gigantic Ki Blast during expert missions
[*]Distance Scaling will now be correctly saved when closing the game
[*]Boost/Step can now be correctly rebound on Keyboards
[*]Innocence Cannon Super Attack now works properly under some circumstances
[*]Several multiplayer improvements (such as infinite loading rooms)
[*]Several stability improvements and crashes fixed 
[*]Several text, translations & cutscenes issues fixed. 
[/list]

[h1]Skills changelist[/h1]
[list]
[*]Justice Combination: Adjusted the Z Vanish so that it is possible to dodge the final hit of a combo.
[*]Neo Wolf Fang Fist: The amout of damage that can be done has increased.  
[*]Feint Shot: Hit rate of the Ki Blasts have been adjusted.
[*]Dragon Fist: The attack has been adjusted to hit the opponent, if launched after the first Hit of a combo.
[*]Saiyan Spirit: The attack has been adjusted to hit the opponent, if launched after the first Hit of a combo.
[*]x20 Kaioken Kamehameha: The attack has been adjusted to hit the opponent, if launched after the first Hit of a combo.
[*]Dust Attack: The recovery time needed to launch a Z Vanish after being hit by the attack has been shortened. Making it possible to dodge the opponent's Heavy Smash by locking on to opponent and performing a Z Vanish.
[*]Solar Flare: The recovery time needed to launch a Z Vanish after being hit by the attack has been shortened. Making it possible to dodge the opponent's Heavy Smash by locking on to opponent and performing a Z Vanish.
[*]All Clear: Adjusted the issue where the attack was counted as multiple hits, even when guarded.
[*]God of Destruction’s Anger: The opponent's Stun Recovery time has been shortened.
[*]Meteor Crash: It is now possible to dodge the attack by performing a Z Vanish, while being blown away.
[*]Phantom Fist: The amount of Ki consumed when Phantom Fist is performed right after the first Phantom Fist, and the amount consumed when the Phantom Fist is performed after a combo, has been adjusted so that they are equal.
[*]Prelude to Destruction: The opponent's Stun Recovery time has been shortened.
[*]Final Blow: Adjusted so that it is possible to perform a recovery, even when hit near the ground.
[*]Dodoria Headbutt: The opponent's Stun Recovery time has been shortened.
Super Dragon Fist: Adjusted so that it is possible to perform a recovery, even when hit near the ground.
[*]God Breaker: The Ki is now consumed when the attack is launched, rather than when it hits.
[*]Flash Bomber: The amount of damage done has been reduced.
[*]Burning Spin: the attack will now blow away opponents when it hits, do more damage with one hit and the lock to the opponent will be kept after the attack.
[*]Reverse Mabakusenko: The Ki is now consumed when the attack is launched, rather than when it hits.
[*]Go-Go Gum: The amount of time needed to launch Go-Go Gum has been increased.
[/list]

Thank you for your support, let us know in the forums if you encounter new or uncorrected issues!
